attributes.powers:
At the start of your turn, reveal this card to recharge the ally Appleslayer or the ally Keren Rhinn from your discard pile.

Recharge this card to add 1d6 to your Disable check or your check against a card that has the Construct or Trap trait. 

Discard this card to explore your location.
